root_cause_label: Wrong Environment Targeted + Misdiagnosed Root Cause (NumPy 2.x Compatibility Patch Never Applied)
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent assumed the ModuleNotFoundError was an installation corruption and spent the entire trajectory reinstalling fasttext and targeting the wrong venv interpreter, never diagnosing or patching the actual NumPy 2.x incompatibility in /usr/local/lib/python3.13/site-packages/fasttext/FastText.py.
t_err_evidence: uninstalling the current version and then reinstalling it. This should resolve any corruption or incorrect installation issues.
t_commit_evidence: After reinstalling fasttext at step 3 and still seeing ModuleNotFoundError (step 4), the agent locked into a path of repeated reinstalls, version changes, and venv targeting without ever reading FastText.py; it never recovered to the correct fix.
t_surface_evidence: The reinstallation was successful... import fasttext / ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'fasttext'
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed the ModuleNotFoundError was caused by a corrupted or incorrectly installed package rather than by a NumPy 2.x API incompatibility inside FastText.py. This led it to pursue reinstalls and environment path fixes rather than inspecting and patching the actual source code.
